## Problem

What are you trying to do that is awkward or impossible today?

## Proposal

What should vardiya grow (API shape, behavior, docs)? Keep it concrete.

## Alternatives

Anything you already tried, or other queues that solve this.

## Scope note

vardiya targets a single SQLite file on one machine (or a small set of processes sharing that file). Features that need multi-server brokers belong in Redis/Postgres queues, not here.
